TDS is the most reliable and practical method for assessing exposure to chemical substances through foods.

the TDS is a powerful tool for the assessment of the exposure to chemical substances from the diet and the TDS results can be used to assess the safety of food in the diet and to set food safety limits for chemical substances in foods.

the TDS is an effective tool to estimate the dietary intake of hazardous materials in a population and the results of the study can be used for the establishment of food safety control policies and risk management.

providing a more comprehensive approach to food safety management by using the TDS results in the future.
the safety reference values of chemical hazards in foods and the safety management based on TDS.
the safety of diets in the public health sense.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
TDS is an indispensable part of the public health system in any country and should be implemented as soon as possible.
TDS is an important tool for estimating dietary exposure to hazardous substances in the population and for setting safety reference values.
‘TDS is a tool for estimating exposure to chemical substances in the diets of the population, and is a valuable tool for assessing food safety and risk management’.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

TDS can provide more accurate estimates of dietary exposure to chemical substances and thus, can be utilized for the establishment of food safety standards and specifications in the public health point of view.
the TDS is a powerful tool to estimate the exposure level of hazardous materials through analysis of the table-ready food samples and to evaluate the safety of foods and diets.
TDS would be the best way for a more comprehensive food safety control in Korea.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the current food safety management in Korea has been too much focused on the presence of hazardous materials and not on the preservation of beneficial materials in foods.

TDS can be used as an effective tool to provide the basis of food safety control in a more comprehensive way, and the results from TDS can also be applied for other purposes such as the establishment of safety reference values, the assessment of dietary exposure, and the evaluation of food safety management system.
TDS should be a part of the public health system in Korea, and it is the time for us to take a step forward to the next generation of food safety management system.
